note: libultra functions the game calls that the native runtime (runtime/ultra.c) implements instead of recompiling. Identified from their pseudocode: struct offsets, hardware registers and event numbers of libultra.

functions.name: osInitialize
functions.evidence: first call of the entry code

functions.name: osCreateThread
functions.evidence: fills OSThread: id +0x14, pri +4, entry, arg, sp - 0x10

functions.name: osStartThread
functions.evidence: ramMain: after osCreateThread of the idle thread

functions.name: osSetThreadPri
functions.evidence: writes +4 of the thread (or __osRunningThread when 0) and reschedules

functions.name: osViSetSpecialFeatures
functions.evidence: control bits of __osViNext from flag pairs

functions.name: osSpTaskStartGo
functions.evidence: waits SP DMA, writes SP status 0x125

functions.name: __osSiRawStartDma
functions.evidence: (direction, buf): SI DRAM address, PIF RAM 0x1fc007c0 read/write; the Pfs code waits for the SI event

functions.name: bzero
functions.evidence: stores zeros (8 words per loop); clears segments before load and the object list at race start

functions.name: __osDisableInt
functions.evidence: mfc0 Status; clear IE; return old IE

functions.name: __osGetActiveQueue
functions.evidence: returns *0x800eb3ac (thread list), used by the crash screen

functions.name: osContInit
functions.evidence: 500 ms wait from boot, then PIF query

functions.name: osContStartReadData
functions.evidence: PIF read command, waits on the queue

functions.name: osContGetReadData
functions.evidence: fills 6-byte OSContPad entries from PIF RAM
